description: This file contains the definition of the ISimpleGrain interface and the SimpleGrain class, which implements a grain with simple set and get operations involving two integer properties A and B. It facilitates setting, incrementing, and retrieving the product of A and B within a Orleans testing environment.

classes.name: SimpleGrain
classes.description: A grain class that implements ISimpleGrain, providing methods to set, increment, and multiply internal integer properties A and B.

methods.name: SetA
methods.description: Sets the value of property A.

methods.name: SetB
methods.description: Sets the value of property B.

methods.name: IncrementA
methods.description: Increments the value of property A by one.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Returns the product of properties A and B; overloaded to accept parameters a and b for multiplication.

methods.name: GetA
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of property A.
